title: Ugali
description: Ugali is a Kenya classic prepared with cornmeal. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 9 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Pour cornmeal in a steady stream into boiling salted water, beat hard and cook until the ugali pulls away from the pot.
Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
